title: Cohort-Strata Prioritizer: workload-aware roadmap scoring and cycle allocation
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Our current RICE-style prioritization treats all feature requests and initiatives as if they affect a homogeneous population. In practice, different workload cohorts (interactive chat, bulk embeddings, reranking pipelines, regulated/personal-data customers) have different latency sensitivity and token-economics. This causes prioritization decisions that optimize for aggregate metrics but under-serve high-SLO or high-cost cohorts.

Goal: Implement a Cohort-Strata Prioritizer: a roadmap scoring framework that extends RICE with workload strata multipliers and cycle-aware allocation. The system will produce both a single "global" rank and a set of cohort-specific ranks; it will also simulate cycle allocations given capacity constraints and examine trade-offs between latency SLOs, unit token cost, and feature impact.

Core idea (high level):
1) Define workload strata (interactive-chat, batch-embedding, rerank, private-regulated). These are derived from routing tags + customer profile.
2) Compute base RICE score per initiative: Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort (standard).
3) For each stratum, compute two multipliers: LatencySensitivityFactor (LSF) and TokenEconFactor (TEF). LSF >1 when initiative materially reduces latency for that stratum; TEF >1 when initiative reduces per-token cost or increases quality-per-token for that stratum.
4) Final score per stratum = BaseRICE * (1 + alpha*LSF + beta*TEF) where alpha/beta configurable per cycle.
5) Global score = weighted sum of stratum scores using cohort traffic share or strategic weight.
6) Simulator: given expected capacity (GPU-hours, reserved slots) and latency budgets across strata, run scenario sampling to allocate N initiatives into the next cycle and compute projected SLO attainment and cost delta.

Why different from existing approaches: we explicitly treat cohort-level impact and allow product to tune strategic weights (e.g., prioritize regulatory cohorts even if reach is small). It pairs prioritization with a cycle allocator (not just ranking) and produces operational KPIs to validate decisions.

Non-goals: Not trying to replace in-depth ROI models for a single enterprise deal. This is a roadmap-level prioritizer for prioritization cycles and OKR planning.
acceptance_criteria: Definition and canonical list of workload strata documented and wired to routing tags (ENG-23841) per prod dataset
Scoring UI prototype in Console that shows base RICE, LSF, TEF, per-stratum score, and global score
Simulator runnable in CI (notebook + lightweight service) that accepts capacity constraints and returns allocation sets with projected latency/cost impact
Exportable CSV of ranked initiatives with score breakdown and a simple visualization (stacked bars by stratum) for PM/exec review
Feature flags exist to turn cohort weighting on/off; default behavior remains classic RICE until we graduate

comments: 2025-01-09 | Asha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes - ENG and Design aligned on strata concept. We will start with four strata: interactive-chat, batch-embed, rerank, private-regulated. Action: Marco to produce spec by 1/17.

2025-01-14 | Marco López: First draft spec uploaded to Confluence (link below). Questions for Eng: do we already have reliable routing tags at request level? ENG-23841 tracks gaps. If not, fallback is customer-level cohort tagging.

2025-01-16 | Priya Rao (Eng): Routing tags exist for 85% of traffic; missing for older SDK customers. Proposal: daily inferred cohort job with conservative defaults for missing tags. Will affect confidence value in scoring.

2025-01-21 | Desi Nguyen (Design): Uploaded Console mock v1 - shows per-initiative stacked bar with stratum slices and global score. Feedback: need to surface which strata drove the decision and allow toggling strategic weights.

2025-01-28 | Marco López: Simulator prototype (notebook) ran three scenarios. Key observation: when regulatory cohort weight is 2x, smaller initiatives (effort <= 3) targeting private-regulated move to top-5 even if reach small. Attached sample output CSV.

2025-02-03 | Anand Mehta (Analytics): Ran sensitivity sweep on alpha/beta parameters. Recommendation: start with alpha=0.6, beta=0.4 for cycle Q1 2025 so latency sensitivity has slightly higher influence than token econ. Saved sweep dashboards.

2025-02-07 | Eva Chen (Customer Success): Suggest including a 'customer-who-reported' tag for initiatives where a named customer is impacted; allow PMs to mark these as "strategic override" in UI to ensure exec visibility.

2025-02-10 | Marco López: Merged early PR for cohort distribution job into feature branch (github.com/redwood/roadmap-sim/pull/58). Still blocked on Design review for final Console controls (DES-8773).

2025-02-12 | Asha Patel: Planning to run alpha prioritization exercise with Growth and Platform PMs during Cycle review on 2025-02-20. Goal: validate simulator recommendations against PM intuition and collect acceptance feedback.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: (1) using cohort weights introduces strategic bias — must be surfaced to execs and auditable; (2) inferred cohorts increase uncertainty; we will show confidence bands in simulator outputs. Next steps: finalize spec, finish telemetry job, unblock DES-8773 for UI controls, run alpha on 2025-02-20.
